scripts.//dev:all: API + autoscaling workers + simulated charger fleet + web UI. This is the one to run for the demo. The fleet process is what a real deployment does NOT have: real chargers send those events themselves.
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n server,workers,fleet,web -c blue,magenta,cyan,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:workers" "npm run traffic" "npm run dev"
scripts.//dev:quiet: Same, without the simulated fleet. Sessions then age until the reaper closes them and the fleet settles at zero in use.
scripts.dev:quiet: concurrently -n server,workers,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:workers" "npm run dev"
scripts.//setup:db: Create the database, load both schemas, drop the billing triggers, geocode stations.
scripts.//seed:activity: Shape the data to look like a live network: spread bulk history, put a realistic share of chargers mid-session. Re-run after a load test.
scripts.//traffic: Continuous, human-paced traffic through the real API: starts sessions on a daily demand curve, ends them naturally, heartbeats the fleet. Run alongside the app to keep a 24/7 deployment alive.
scripts.//selftest: Verify the EXIF / PDF / classifier code with no database and no server.
scripts.//doctor: Full invariant check: schema, referential integrity, operational state, physics, money, time, liveness, API consistency. Run before packaging for anyone else.
scripts.//loadtest: Fire the traffic spike. Watch the Cloud Ops page while it runs.
scripts.docker:logs: docker compose logs -f api worker web
